what must a developer publish or report.quote: - (c) (1) Before, or concurrently with, deploying a new frontier model
what must a developer publish or report.note: Core statutory pre-deployment transparency report mandate (§22757.12(c)): required website disclosures for all frontier developers (website, contact mechanism, release date, languages, output modalities, intended uses, restrictions) and large developers (summaries of catastrophic risk assessments, assessment results, third-party evaluators involved, framework compliance steps; system card/model card compliance).

what must a developer publish or report.note: Mandate for large frontier developers to publish on their website a frontier AI framework (§22757.12(a)), including approaches to standards, risk thresholds, mitigations, deployment reviews, third-party assessments, weight cybersecurity, incident response, and governance.

what must a developer publish or report.quote: - (e) (1) "Deploy" means to make a frontier model available to a third party
what must a developer publish or report.note: Statutory definition of 'Deploy' (§22757.11(e)), distinguishing public/third-party deployment from internal development and evaluation.

what must a developer publish or report.quote: - (b) (1) A large frontier developer shall review and, as appropriate, update its frontier AI framework
what must a developer publish or report.note: Requirement (§22757.12(b)) to review the framework annually and publish material modifications and justifications within 30 days.

what must a developer publish or report.quote: - (d) A large frontier developer shall transmit to the Office of Emergency Services
what must a developer publish or report.note: Reporting requirement (§22757.12(d)) to transmit quarterly summaries of catastrophic risk assessments from internal use to Cal OES.

what must a developer publish or report.quote: - (e) (1) (A) A frontier developer shall not make a materially false or misleading statement
what must a developer publish or report.note: Prohibition (§22757.12(e)) against making materially false or misleading statements regarding catastrophic risk or framework compliance.

what must a developer publish or report.quote: - (f) (1) When a frontier developer publishes documents to comply with this section
what must a developer publish or report.note: Provisions (§22757.12(f)) governing permitted redactions for trade secrets, cybersecurity, public safety, or national security, and requiring 5-year retention of unredacted versions.
